description: What visitors seem to hesitate over: how many sessions of the last 7 days the model read each doubt in — price, delivery, returns, trust and so on — most first. The same figure as your human's console. Counts, never shares, and Cromanion's reading rather than anything visitors said. Needs the visits permission; counts against the history budget.

siteId.description: Which site this call is about. Only needed when your credential covers more than one — cromanion_grants lists them and says whether it is required. Omitting it with several is refused rather than guessed at.

name: cromanion_doubts

earlyDays.description: Present when doubts were recorded only from `since` partway through the window.

reading.description: `{ sessions, rows: [{ kind, sessions }] }`: sessions with at least one doubt read, and one row per doubt, most first.

unit.description: Always `sessions` — the console's unit, not stitched visits.
